dataset.method: Instrumented Swing readiness, no forced GC; graceful platform exit saves settings and VFS between cached launches. Fresh application config is not cold OS cache. Includes attach/poll overhead. Stable samples require no scanner/queued scan, no dumb mode, no visible progress and unchanged scanner start/stop event count across two observations. Log readiness requires rows in the selected central editor, not another visible graph.

readiness: Nonzero rows in visible original graph inside selected central FileEditor, not any other visible Log. Stable scan uses actual start/stop event counter.
checks: All seven launches, including warmup, use same ZIP and normal platform shutdown
No severe/error, VFS crash recovery or interrupted scanning in final logs
Actual selected central-editor graph has commits
Final no scan, queued scan, dumb state or running progress
limits: Fresh application configuration is not cold OS cache
Working-tree size and history depth are separate datasets; not one repository combining both extremes
Attach/poll overhead included; scan settled time is an observed readiness timestamp, not pure indexing CPU duration
Diff measured after scan settles; memory sampled after grace, not peak or forced-GC retained set
